notes: Absolute host and Klipper timestamps were removed; receive offsets are relative to the first response in each trace.
Receive offsets measure host response delivery; they do not prove ADC conversion time or that duplicate values represent distinct conversions.
Counts decode the first three response bytes as signed little-endian 24-bit integers; the fourth byte was zero in every retained response.
idle_outlier_count uses abs(counts - trace median) > 5000 only to summarize idle captures; it is not an accepted production quality gate.
